THE SAMPLE PERSONAL DATA RULES, 2099
A FICTIONAL TEST FIXTURE. NOT THE TEXT OF ANY LAW.
Short title.
1. These Rules may be called the Sample Personal Data Rules, 2099.
Definitions.
2. Words used in these Rules have the meaning given in the Act.
Notice by fiduciary.
3. The notice under section 5 shall be understandable independently of other information and shall list each item of personal data with its specific purpose.
Intimation of breach.
4. (1) On becoming aware of a breach, the fiduciary shall intimate each affected person without delay.
(2) The fiduciary shall give the Board a detailed report within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of the breach.
